title: Wall St. falls for 6th straight day; Dow drops below 50,000 for first time since June as AMD plunges on short report
summary: The S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7,175.83 on November 19, Nasdaq lost 2.25%, and the Dow dropped 1,101 points to 49,097, its first close below 50,000 since June — the longest losing streak for the S&P since April 2024. AMD tumbled ~8-11% after Hunterbrook Capital disclosed a short position and published a report alleging AMD firmware appeared in servers from a US-blacklisted Chinese firm, alongside new US export licensing rules. Tech sector broadly sold off despite Anthropic's IPO debut.
why: 美股六连跌且道指跌破5万点，芯片股承压；AMD暴跌叠加出口管制新规，可能波及整个半导体赛道；隐含波动率预计上升，持有芯片或科技期权头寸需评估风险。

title: Anthropic (ANT) raises record $81.3B in IPO, debuts +34% at $111.50 and closes up 17% at $97.17
summary: Anthropic's Class A shares (ticker: ANT) priced at $83 on November 18 — above the $70-$78 range — opened on Nasdaq at $111.50 on November 19 and closed at $97.17, up 17.07%. The AI safety company raised $81.3 billion, the largest US tech IPO on record, valuing it at approximately $1.76 trillion including restricted shares. The blockbuster debut failed to lift the broader market, which fell for a sixth straight session.
why: AI行业最大IPO刷新融资记录，以约1.76万亿美元市值定价为AI行业头部公司的估值提供参照；上市当日大盘续跌说明市场对高估值AI资产的情绪较谨慎；对持仓AI相关科技股的中期估值逻辑有参考价值。

title: Nvidia board rules out Jensen Huang's return; interim CEO Kress tells staff 'we've got this' after Q3 results released
summary: Nvidia's board said on November 17 it has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, who resigned on November 12 amid personal conduct allegations and a potential security-related probe. Interim CEO Colette Kress addressed all staff on November 18, confirming the Q3 FY2027 roadmap is on track. The company reported $28.1B in buybacks and Harvey C. Jones was named Nvidia's first-ever board chair. Huang has been summoned for a closed-door Congressional interview on December 1.
why: 黄仁勋辞职引发的管理层真空仍在持续：董事会明确拒绝其回归，永久CEO人选未定，12月国会听证可能带来新进展；$281亿回购计划是实质性利好；期权策略需关注管理层更替引发的隐含波动率溢价，以及供应链合同续签风险。

title: 腾讯三季度营收2073亿同比增8%，WorkBuddy日活破千万，但AI重投致资本开支暴增527%、自由现金流转负
summary: 腾讯2026年三季度营收2073.36亿元（+8%，低于市场预期2105亿）；非国际准则归母净利润同比下降6%；资本开支约814亿元同比大增约527%；自由现金流为负691亿元（剔除算力采购预付款后约正169亿）。云收入同比增长35%，WorkBuddy日活跃用户超1000万，营销服务收入+19%至430亿。股价18日跌超6%至348港元附近，创2024年8月以来新低。机构下调目标价：摩根士丹利→480，招银→670，中金→470港元。
why: AI超重资本投入拖累利润与现金流，但WorkBuddy日活数据显示AI商业化已初显成果；多家机构下调目标价，短期悲观情绪压制股价；对0700.HK期权头寸的Delta/Vega影响较大，建议重新评估行权价设置。

title: Alibaba Q2 FY2027: revenue RMB271.5B edges past estimates; EPS RMB8.10 badly misses as AI and instant retail investment weighs
summary: Alibaba's September 2026 quarter (fiscal Q2 FY2027) revenue was RMB271.5 billion, fractionally above the RMB270.5 billion consensus. EPS of RMB8.10 missed the RMB10.75 estimate by a wide margin. AI-related cloud revenue grew 53% YoY and external cloud revenues surged 64%. Profitability was squeezed by heavy investment in AI infrastructure and instant retail logistics. The 9988.HK stock hit a 52-week low around Nov 19.
why: 营收略超预期但EPS大幅不及，与腾讯同期业绩结构类似，AI重投正在拖累整个中国大科技的盈利；9988.HK已触52周低位，sell put面临持续下行压力需重新评估行权价；AI云增速53%是中长期亮点，平头哥IPO进程亦在推进中。

title: PDD Q3 2026: revenue +9% YoY as China business recovers, Temu reaches profit inflection point; stock falls ~6-7%
summary: PDD Holdings reported Q3 2026 results on November 19 before US market open. Revenue grew approximately 9% year over year, with China domestic business recovering and operating profit rebounding on a low base. Temu's international operations reached a profit inflection point despite EU regulatory headwinds (€3/parcel duty in effect since July). PDD stock fell 6-7% during the November 19 session amid the broader market selloff.
why: Temu盈利拐点是关键里程碑，但营收增速放缓至9%反映国内竞争加剧；欧盟关税和监管整改是持续压力；股价已有较大跌幅，部分负面预期已计入，可关注sell put机会。

title: DBS and Circle launch 24/7 institutional USDC minting in Asia, first major Asian bank to offer round-the-clock settlement
summary: On November 18, DBS Bank and Circle announced a partnership allowing eligible institutional clients in Asia to mint and redeem USDC directly through DBS with 24/7 settlement. DBS is the first major Asian bank to offer institutional-grade USDC access. CRCL stock fell ~5% the prior week after Q3 results showed reserve income down 8% YoY, though the company reported total revenue up 17% YoY driven by ARC token presale revenue.
why: 亚洲最大银行接入USDC 24小时铸币渠道是机构级稳定币采用的重要里程碑，可能推动USDC供应量回升、为CRCL提供估值支撑；与美国GENIUS稳定币法案立法进程共振；关注储备金收入增速是否回升。
